rows: The proposed $5\times2$ reading contains five groups but not five pairs. The $2\times4$ reading references a $3\times4$ grid that does not describe the Ogdoad.
Retain valid partitions; label other arrangements as proposed regroupings rather than established decompositions.
The half × role partition is called unique, although the witnessed six pairs alone do not force it.
Preserve it as the adopted conditional overlay, not a mathematical necessity.
The text first treats the 23rd functional class as unresolved, then declares 23 the true functional count.
Keep $22+1=24-1=23$ as a proposed seam construction. Do not promote it to an established symbol inventory.
The equations conflate reciprocal ratios: $8/9\ne9/8$, and $88/99=8/9$, not $9/8$\.
